get_organization.title: Get organization
get_organization.description: Get the Candis organization the authorised user belongs to: its id (the slug every other Candis tool takes as organization_id) and name. Call this first.

output.description: The organization.

create_export.title: Create an export
create_export.description: Export every posting that is ready to export (approved invoices by default, or reimbursement items or card transactions) and mark them exported in Candis. Runs asynchronously: the export starts in status EXPORTING; poll get_export until it is EXPORTED, PARTIALLY_EXPORTED or FAILED, then read list_export_postings. Fails with EXPORTABLE_POSTINGS_NOT_FOUND when nothing is ready.
create_export.notes: Exported postings leave the ready-to-export queue, so the same postings are not exported twice.

organization_id.description: The organization's id (slug), e.g. alpha-organization. Find it with get_organization.

entity_type.description: Kind of postings to export (Candis default DOCUMENT, i.e. invoices).

output.description: The new export.

list_exports.title: List exports
list_exports.description: List the organization's past exports with id, status, postings count and creation time, paginated with offset and limit. Use get_export for one export and list_export_postings for its data.

organization_id.description: The organization's id (slug), e.g. alpha-organization. Find it with get_organization.

offset.description: Number of items to skip (0 for the first page).

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return; 50 is both the default and the maximum.

output.description: `exports` plus `pagination`.

get_export.title: Get an export
get_export.description: Get one export's status (EXPORTING, EXPORTED, PARTIALLY_EXPORTED or FAILED), postings count and creation time. Poll this after create_export; once it is no longer EXPORTING, fetch list_export_postings.

organization_id.description: The organization's id (slug), e.g. alpha-organization. Find it with get_organization.

export_id.description: The export id (from create_export or list_exports).

output.description: The Candis response.

list_export_postings.title: List an export's postings
list_export_postings.description: Get the postings of a finished export: successfulPostings with their booking data (amounts, contact, invoice number and date, splits, cost centres, tax codes) and file links (invoice PDF, XML, audit trail), and failedPostings with the reason each failed. Download files with download_file.

organization_id.description: The organization's id (slug), e.g. alpha-organization. Find it with get_organization.

export_id.description: The export id (from create_export or list_exports).

output.description: Exported and failed postings.

download_file.title: Download a file
download_file.description: Download a file referenced by an export posting (an invoice PDF or e-invoice XML, or an audit trail) by its id. The body is the file itself: XML is readable as text, a PDF is binary.

organization_id.description: The organization's id (slug), e.g. alpha-organization. Find it with get_organization.

file_id.description: File id, from the `files` of a posting in list_export_postings.

output.description: The file content (PDF or XML).

list_invoices.title: List invoices
list_invoices.description: List the organization's invoices as read-only metadata: status, timestamps, amounts and currency, discounts and payment terms, payment status and dates, invoice number and date, document type, purchase order number, contact, bank details and an archiveUrl to the document. Filter by status and invoice or update date; paginate with offset/limit. For accounting data use the export tools instead.

organization_id.description: The organization's id (slug), e.g. alpha-organization. Find it with get_organization.

offset.description: Number of items to skip (0 for the first page).

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return; 50 is both the default and the maximum.

status.description: Only invoices in these statuses: APPROVED (approved, not yet exported), EXPORTED (exported to accounting), OPEN (approval started).

invoice_date_from.description: Only invoices issued at or after this ISO 8601 date-time.

invoice_date_to.description: Only invoices issued at or before this ISO 8601 date-time.

updated_date_from.description: Only invoices updated at or after this ISO 8601 date-time.

updated_date_to.description: Only invoices updated at or before this ISO 8601 date-time.

output.description: `invoices` plus `pagination`.

update_invoice_payment.title: Update an invoice's payment status
update_invoice_payment.description: Mark an invoice as paid (with the payment date) or unpaid. This is the only invoice field the API can change.

organization_id.description: The organization's id (slug), e.g. alpha-organization. Find it with get_organization.

invoice_id.description: Unique identifier of the invoice (from list_invoices).

paid_at.description: Date the invoice was paid, ISO 8601. Required when is_paid is true.

output.description: Empty on success (HTTP 204).

list_purchase_requests.title: List purchase requests
list_purchase_requests.description: List the organization's purchase requests with their status, requester, amounts, line items and approval data. Filter by status and creation or update date, sort by CREATED_AT or UPDATED_AT, and paginate with offset/limit.

organization_id.description: The organization's id (slug), e.g. alpha-organization. Find it with get_organization.

offset.description: Number of items to skip (0 for the first page).

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return; 50 is both the default and the maximum.

status.description: Only purchase requests in these statuses.

created_at_from.description: Only requests created at or after this ISO 8601 date-time.

created_at_to.description: Only requests created at or before this ISO 8601 date-time.

updated_at_from.description: Only requests updated at or after this ISO 8601 date-time.

updated_at_to.description: Only requests updated at or before this ISO 8601 date-time.

output.description: `purchaseRequests` plus `pagination`.

list_reimbursement_items.title: List reimbursement items
list_reimbursement_items.description: List the organization's approved or exported employee reimbursement items (general expenses, hospitality, per diem, mileage) with amounts, dates, bookings and files. Filter by status, type, item date and update date; sort and paginate with offset/limit.

organization_id.description: The organization's id (slug), e.g. alpha-organization. Find it with get_organization.

offset.description: Number of items to skip (0 for the first page).

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return; 50 is both the default and the maximum.

item_date_from.description: Only items dated at or after this ISO 8601 date-time.

item_date_to.description: Only items dated at or before this ISO 8601 date-time.

updated_at_from.description: Only items updated at or after this ISO 8601 date-time.

updated_at_to.description: Only items updated at or before this ISO 8601 date-time.

output.description: `reimbursementItems` plus `pagination`.

create_contacts.title: Create contacts
create_contacts.description: Import new creditor or debtor contacts into Candis in bulk. Each contact needs a name and either an accounts-payable or an accounts-receivable number. Use update_contacts to change existing ones.
create_contacts.notes: Imports are asynchronous (HTTP 202): the records are validated and applied after the call returns, so check get_import_logs with the returned processId.

organization_id.description: The organization's id (slug), e.g. alpha-organization. Find it with get_organization.

contacts.description: Contacts to create: objects with name, each with either accountPayableNumber (a creditor/supplier) or accountReceivableNumber (a debtor/customer), plus {vatId?, taxNumber?, paymentType? SEPA|INTERNATIONAL, iban?, bic?, paymentConditionName?}.

output.description: The accepted import job; pass `processId` to get_import_logs to follow it.

processId.description: Id of the asynchronous import job.

update_contacts.title: Update contacts
update_contacts.description: Update existing contacts in bulk, matched by their accounts-payable or accounts-receivable number; set isArchived to archive or restore one.
update_contacts.notes: Imports are asynchronous (HTTP 202): the records are validated and applied after the call returns, so check get_import_logs with the returned processId.

organization_id.description: The organization's id (slug), e.g. alpha-organization. Find it with get_organization.

contacts.description: Contacts to update: objects each with either accountPayableNumber (a creditor/supplier) or accountReceivableNumber (a debtor/customer), plus {vatId?, taxNumber?, paymentType? SEPA|INTERNATIONAL, iban?, bic?, paymentConditionName?}, plus optional name and isArchived.

output.description: The accepted import job; pass `processId` to get_import_logs to follow it.

processId.description: Id of the asynchronous import job.

create_cost_dimensions.title: Create cost centers and cost objects
create_cost_dimensions.description: Import new cost dimensions in bulk: cost centers, cost objects or custom cost dimensions. Use update_cost_dimensions to rename or archive.
create_cost_dimensions.notes: Imports are asynchronous (HTTP 202): the records are validated and applied after the call returns, so check get_import_logs with the returned processId.

organization_id.description: The organization's id (slug), e.g. alpha-organization. Find it with get_organization.

cost_dimensions.description: Cost dimensions to create: objects of {code, name, type: COST_CENTER | COST_OBJECT | CUSTOM_COST_DIMENSION}.

output.description: The accepted import job; pass `processId` to get_import_logs to follow it.

processId.description: Id of the asynchronous import job.

update_cost_dimensions.title: Update cost centers and cost objects
update_cost_dimensions.description: Update existing cost centers, cost objects or custom cost dimensions in bulk, matched by code and type; rename them or set isArchived.
update_cost_dimensions.notes: Imports are asynchronous (HTTP 202): the records are validated and applied after the call returns, so check get_import_logs with the returned processId.

organization_id.description: The organization's id (slug), e.g. alpha-organization. Find it with get_organization.

cost_dimensions.description: Cost dimensions to update: objects of {code, type: COST_CENTER | COST_OBJECT | CUSTOM_COST_DIMENSION, name?, isArchived?}.

output.description: The accepted import job; pass `processId` to get_import_logs to follow it.

processId.description: Id of the asynchronous import job.

create_general_ledger_accounts.title: Create general ledger accounts
create_general_ledger_accounts.description: Import new general ledger accounts in bulk, each an account code and a label.
create_general_ledger_accounts.notes: Imports are asynchronous (HTTP 202): the records are validated and applied after the call returns, so check get_import_logs with the returned processId.

organization_id.description: The organization's id (slug), e.g. alpha-organization. Find it with get_organization.

accounts.description: Accounts to create: objects of {accountCode, name}.

output.description: The accepted import job; pass `processId` to get_import_logs to follow it.

processId.description: Id of the asynchronous import job.

update_general_ledger_accounts.title: Update general ledger accounts
update_general_ledger_accounts.description: Update existing general ledger accounts in bulk, matched by accountCode; rename them or set isArchived to deactivate.
update_general_ledger_accounts.notes: Imports are asynchronous (HTTP 202): the records are validated and applied after the call returns, so check get_import_logs with the returned processId.

organization_id.description: The organization's id (slug), e.g. alpha-organization. Find it with get_organization.

accounts.description: Accounts to update: objects of {accountCode, name?, isArchived?}.

output.description: The accepted import job; pass `processId` to get_import_logs to follow it.

tax_codes.description: Tax codes to create: objects of {taxCode, taxPercentage, description}.

update_tax_codes.notes: Imports are asynchronous (HTTP 202): the records are validated and applied after the call returns, so check get_import_logs with the returned processId.

tax_codes.description: Tax codes to update: objects of {taxCode, taxPercentage?, description?, isArchived?}.

create_payment_conditions.title: Create payment conditions

create_payment_conditions.notes: Imports are asynchronous (HTTP 202): the records are validated and applied after the call returns, so check get_import_logs with the returned processId.

organization_id.description: The organization's id (slug), e.g. alpha-organization. Find it with get_organization.

payment_conditions.description: Payment conditions to create: objects of {name, dueDate (days, 0-999), discountRate? (0.01-99.99), discountDueDate? (days, required with discountRate)}.

output.description: The accepted import job; pass `processId` to get_import_logs to follow it.

processId.description: Id of the asynchronous import job.

update_payment_conditions.title: Update payment conditions
update_payment_conditions.description: Update existing payment conditions in bulk, matched by name; change terms or set isArchived.
update_payment_conditions.notes: Imports are asynchronous (HTTP 202): the records are validated and applied after the call returns, so check get_import_logs with the returned processId.

organization_id.description: The organization's id (slug), e.g. alpha-organization. Find it with get_organization.

payment_conditions.description: Payment conditions to update: objects of {name, dueDate?, discountRate?, discountDueDate?, isArchived?}.

output.description: The accepted import job; pass `processId` to get_import_logs to follow it.

import_purchase_orders.title: Import purchase orders
import_purchase_orders.description: Import purchase orders from an ERP for three-way matching. Idempotent: an order with the same orderNumber is updated rather than duplicated. Amounts are gross (tax-inclusive).
import_purchase_orders.notes: Imports are asynchronous (HTTP 202): the records are validated and applied after the call returns, so check get_import_logs with the returned processId.

organization_id.description: The organization's id (slug), e.g. alpha-organization. Find it with get_organization.

purchase_orders.description: Purchase orders: objects of {orderNumber, amount {value, currency}, documentDate, postingDate, dueDate, accountsPayableNumber, contactName, purchaseOrderType GOODS|SERVICE, status OPEN|PAID|DELIVERED|CLOSED, vendorReferenceNumber?, erpData {system, externalId, createdAt?, updatedAt?}, lineItems [{lineNumber, itemNumber, type ITEM|SERVICE|ADDITIONAL_DELIVERY_COST, description, taxCode, netAmount, taxAmount, grossAmount, quantity?, openQuantity?, unitPrice?, generalLedgerAccount?, costCenter?, costObject?, customCostDimension?, projectCode?, locationCode?, externalId?, goodsReceiptsMetadata [{receiptNumber, lineNumber?, lineId?}]}] (max 1000 line items)}.

output.description: The accepted import job; pass `processId` to get_import_logs to follow it.

processId.description: Id of the asynchronous import job.

update_purchase_orders.title: Update purchase orders
update_purchase_orders.description: Update existing purchase orders, matched by orderNumber; every other field is optional.
update_purchase_orders.notes: Imports are asynchronous (HTTP 202): the records are validated and applied after the call returns, so check get_import_logs with the returned processId.

organization_id.description: The organization's id (slug), e.g. alpha-organization. Find it with get_organization.

purchase_orders.description: Purchase orders to update: objects with orderNumber plus any fields of {orderNumber, amount {value, currency}, documentDate, postingDate, dueDate, accountsPayableNumber, contactName, purchaseOrderType GOODS|SERVICE, status OPEN|PAID|DELIVERED|CLOSED, vendorReferenceNumber?, erpData {system, externalId, createdAt?, updatedAt?}, lineItems [{lineNumber, itemNumber, type ITEM|SERVICE|ADDITIONAL_DELIVERY_COST, description, taxCode, netAmount, taxAmount, grossAmount, quantity?, openQuantity?, unitPrice?, generalLedgerAccount?, costCenter?, costObject?, customCostDimension?, projectCode?, locationCode?, externalId?, goodsReceiptsMetadata [{receiptNumber, lineNumber?, lineId?}]}] (max 1000 line items)}.

output.description: The accepted import job; pass `processId` to get_import_logs to follow it.

processId.description: Id of the asynchronous import job.

goods_receipts.description: Goods receipts: objects of {receiptNumber, amount {value, currency}, documentDate, postingDate, dueDate, accountsPayableNumber, contactName, goodsReceiptType GOODS|SERVICE, status OPEN|CLOSED, vendorReferenceNumber?, erpMetaData {erpName, externalId, createdAt?, updatedAt?}, lineItems [{lineNumber, itemNumber, type ITEM|SERVICE|ADDITIONAL_DELIVERY_COST, description, lineStatus OPEN|CLOSED, netAmount, taxAmount, grossAmount, quantity?, openQuantity?, unitPrice?, taxCode?, generalLedgerAccount?, costCenter?, costObject?, customCostDimension?, projectCode?, purchaseOrderMetadata?, locationCode?, externalId?}] (max 1000 line items)}.

get_import_logs.title: Get import logs
get_import_logs.description: Get the status of a core data import job (any create_/update_/import_ tool above) and its per-record events: which records were created, updated or rejected and why. Paginate the events with offset/limit.

organization_id.description: The organization's id (slug), e.g. alpha-organization. Find it with get_organization.

process_id.description: The import job id returned as processId by the import tool.

offset.description: Number of items to skip (0 for the first page).

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return; 50 is both the default and the maximum.

output.description: Job status and events.
